scope: Detailed remaining M2–M5 work; preserves prerequisite gates and campaign floors.

preparation.scope: Isolated pure Rust components and verification infrastructure; not linked into either production executable.

packets.title: Introduce fallible byte ownership
implementation_units: Complete xbuffer caller/alias migration after M1.4
packets.exit_gate: Converted leaves forbid unsafe code and have no untracked aliases; unfinished core callers remain explicitly open.

packets.title: Introduce checked coordinates and stable IDs
implementation_units: Checked native narrowing and >4-GiB file offsets
Owner-bound generational handles with permanent retirement on overflow
packets.exit_gate: Invalid values cannot become indexes or revived handles; valid wide offsets preserve existing semantics.

packets.title: Convert byte parsers and companion state
implementation_units: Family-specific byte corpora and in-process harnesses
packets.exit_gate: Malformed input returns defined outcomes without panic or unchecked access; no UTF-8-only or dialect substitution is introduced.

packets.title: Prove leaf safety and integration seams
implementation_units: Alias retirement and component-to-pager integration evidence
packets.exit_gate: No leaf is labeled safe solely because pointers moved into a wrapper; whole-core M3/M5 requirements remain open where applicable.

packets.title: Own configuration and command state
implementation_units: Immutable typed option metadata and typed effects
Owned command/editing/history prefixes and deferred lookup timing
packets.exit_gate: One authoritative owner drives mutation; no global backdoor or duplicate state remains for converted subsystems.

packets.title: Own retained input and navigation
implementation_units: Owned per-file input and retained ranges
packets.exit_gate: Storage reuse cannot revive a view or mark; ordinary paging does not wait for EOF or silently buffer every stream.

packets.title: Own layout search and filters
implementation_units: Cancellation without overlapping borrows or stale retained views
packets.exit_gate: No cross-module pointer persists into replaced storage; rendering/search behavior and cancellation positions remain compatible.

packets.title: Own terminal children and persistence
implementation_units: Fallible idempotent shutdown retaining primary error
packets.exit_gate: Normal/error/catchable-signal paths attempt all required cleanup once; no repeated cancellation or failure leaks children, FDs or ownership.

packets.title: Close the safe-core migration slices
implementation_units: Retire mutable globals and raw core ownership
Remove accidental C exports and legacy alias backdoors
Enforce core policy with a narrow explicit residual boundary
packets.exit_gate: No unfinished core is hidden in an unsafe adapter. Final native proofs and overall safety sign-off remain M4/M5 gates.

packets.title: Select and probe canonical native ABIs
implementation_units: Matching glibc 2.41/2.44 probes and library identities
Minimal native shims with no application control flow
packets.exit_gate: Unsupported ABIs fail clearly; a current-host build does not certify the original glibc 2.41 profile.

packets.title: Finalize owning GNU regex interfaces
implementation_units: Checked full/submatch ranges and native length strategy
Scoped syntax settings and exact GNU semantics
packets.exit_gate: Native ranges and lifetimes are valid; no different regex dialect or uninstrumented-native safety claim is substituted.

packets.title: Finalize terminal signal and callback interfaces
implementation_units: Initialized read bytes and correct write/error semantics
Reviewed callback context, sentinels, errno and no cross-C unwind
packets.exit_gate: Safe APIs establish every raw precondition; callback/context storage cannot dangle or alias a live mutable borrow.

packets.title: Retire legacy boundaries and review dependencies
implementation_units: Retire duplicate native definitions and plumbing
Review vendored/dependency unsafe code and advisories
Remove or narrowly justify C2Rust bitfields
packets.exit_gate: No undocumented unsafe path or hidden pager logic remains outside the allowlist; counts alone do not establish soundness.

packets.title: Complete independent boundary review
packets.exit_gate: Every remaining unsafe/native item has current reviewed evidence; full release campaigns and artifacts still must pass.

packets.title: Establish campaign readiness
packets.exit_gate: No required detector is silently unavailable and no stale input can be reported as passing.

packets.title: Run regression Miri and instrumented campaigns
implementation_units: Complete regression/Miri/instrumented executions on supported ABIs
Reviewed native exclusions with named alternatives
packets.exit_gate: All applicable normal, Miri, ABI and instrumented evidence is current; skipped required checks cannot pass.

packets.title: Complete coverage and real event budgets
implementation_units: 15 independent production fuzz targets with both input and CPU floors
10000 bounded native events and 100 repeats per required race/recovery case
Coverage/resource metrics and reset after relevant changes
packets.exit_gate: Every target/scenario meets its own floor; aggregate counts, sleeps, build time and untriaged hangs do not substitute.

packets.title: Verify exact clean artifacts
packets.exit_gate: The distributed bytes match the tested/reviewed payload and the source archive rebuilds without the C pager.

packets.title: Make the scoped safety completion decision
implementation_units: Scoped safe-core/native trust report with independent approval
packets.exit_gate: SAFE-VER-009 is met. A partial migration, tool failure or clean behavioral suite alone cannot close M5.
